newsitem.title: UK: Cowie seeks expansion after bumper pft rise.
newsitem.headline: Cowie seeks expansion after bumper pft rise.

text.p: Cowie Group Plc, the UK leasing to bus group, flagged further expansion into the urban transport sector through acquisitions on Tuesday after reporting a bumper 46 percent rise in pre-tax profits.

Profits for the year ended December 31 rose to 81.2 million stg compared to 55.8 million last year. Turnover was 1.12 billion versus one billion and the total dividend payout was 12.4 pence, up from 10.4 pence per share.
The group said it had achieved record financial results for each of its sectors.

Turning to plans for the future, Cowie said in a statement "Bus operations are now an integral part of the Group's future development and we will be pursuing opportunities for further service improvements, efficiencies and revenue growth while seeking suitable bolt-on acquisitions in the UK."
Cowie also plans to investigate light rail and tram opportunities in urban centres and look for "strategic advancement in mainland Europe".
This strategy mirrors the pattern being followed by a number of transport groups including Stagecoach Holdings Plc, FirstBus Plc and Go-Ahead Group Plc.
